_comment: Scoring criteria for the Score page. g = primary (the contest's quality criteria) | additional (ours) | bonus (optional track, not in the 100). w = points of the 100 for additional criteria (primary criteria share 70 equally). depth = how many mapped tasks mean a full 5/5. kind = tasks (from ROADMAP tasks matched by keywords) | scope | feasibility | ship | docs. New criteria are proposed through the Skills page (skill project-scoring), never edited by hand; approved ones are saved in Claude/docs/score-criteria-extra.json.

criteria.tip: Make the one twist obvious in the first 30 seconds.
Is the central idea visible without explanation?
Playtest with a stranger and watch where they smile.
Add one layer of progression so round 3 is not round 1.
Pick one style and keep it: a coherent small look beats a mixed rich one.
Landmarks, a clear route, one memorable place.
Music loop, hit and reward sounds, one ambience: cheap points.
Check the risky parts with the MCP recipes before building them; fix open bugs.
Tasks were added since the plan was first measured. Cut one or move the release.
A reason to come back tomorrow: daily goal, unlock, leaderboard.
The publishing checklist: ratings, thumbnails, island settings.
Keep ROADMAP/BUGS in the fixed format and STATUS fresh.
Optional track: a talking NPC with the UEFN conversations feature.
